name: AtmicQuoterv3
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.033 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence None, repo created 2026-09-13. CAVEAT: 1,006 validation queries over an 8,742-passage corpus drawn from the same teaching corpus the training data came from, so the gain is in-domain specialisation on a narrow devotional corpus, not general retrieval ability.
